🖋️ Tattoos: Geometric Band
A band of geometric pattern work encircling an arm, wrist, or other limb — structured, mathematical linework.

Portrait: A narrow band of interlocking abstract angles around one compatible forearm. Ordinary pigment, no written symbols, rank stripes or crests.

Visual selection only: fit it to compatible visible surfaces; never invent limbs, horns, ears or other anatomy. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features. It adds no Quirk effect, item, protection, license or history.
